tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Resolve an exact npm package version (latest when omitted) and read eligible loading evidence across pinned Node.js, Bun and Deno. Never starts a scan. Missing evidence is not failure.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Read a retained report by UUID with runtime pins, coverage, failures, optional peers and current eligibility. Historical reports remain readable. Never starts a scan.
